pinning.rule: Resolve and retain an immutable manifest revision, then verify all three exact Git blobs at their repository paths. Branch URLs are discovery only.
pinning.crossRepositoryPublication: Not atomic; partial publication does not establish an aligned baseline.
pinning.selfReference: Document blobs are pinned instead of circular commit hashes. This manifest does not embed its own digest.

normativeOwnership: Path control port and domain schemas

requirements: One supervisor placement/lease authority, one runner Atomic process adapter and one gateway implementation.
Path owns readiness, journalled state, evidence admission and closeout; supervisor SQLite is separate coordination state.
Authority identity/binding, coordination epoch, service incarnation and applicable assignment/attempt fences remain distinct.
All projects sharing a repository and full target ref share one installation gateway lane.
Human-signed exact-candidate approval is mandatory; policy-only promotion and implicit deployment are disabled.
The exact durable Atomic/Path/supervisor/runner/schema/policy tuple and macOS/Linux isolation profiles must be certified.
Source-branch knowledge and authority-owned contract snapshots compose a provenance-labelled view; the control branch is a history mirror only.
Cancellation never requires starting or resuming work; terminal history is immutable and uncertain effects retain reservations.
Provider-conditional ref mutations and reconciliation of unresolved admitted/submitted effects are mandatory.

evidenceTraceability.reuseRule: Reuse only evidence applicable to the exact source/runtime/policy/profile and measured scope, or a permitted explicit revalidation. Component or mock success is not native-product acceptance.

publicationAuthorization.ownerInstruction: agreed update the specs with the changes and merge in directly
publicationAuthorization.scope: Documentation updates directly to main in Marti-S/PathWorkflow and Marti-S/herdrm; no implementation launch, deployment, protection change or runtime publication.
